name: opencode-exoscale
description: OpenCode plugin: Exoscale inference provider. Registers Exoscale in /connect (API key + optional endpoint, or EXOSCALE_API_KEY env) and discovers models live from the endpoint's /v1/models — no provider or model config in opencode.json.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --allowImportingTsExtensions --target es2022 --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --skipLibCheck --types node index.ts test/index.test.ts
